name: Ysolde
looks: the well-dressed woman with a salt-white collar
background: Ysolde runs salt wagons from the coast and is buying up the border warehouses one debt at a time.
temperament: Cool, calculating and polite; she rarely raises her voice and never forgets a slight.
speech: Measured and courteous, asks questions instead of giving answers, speaks of everything in terms of price.
quirks: Wipes the table before she sets anything on it; tips well and remembers who thanked her.
secret: She holds the note on the inn's mortgage and means to call it in.
goal: Find out who on this road owes money to whom, and buy a debt or two before the night is out.
